overview: The Mosinee School Board Personnel Committee met on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 and approved a consent agenda along with a review of the October in-service schedule and a preview of the November in-service schedule. All motions carried, though vote tallies were not recorded in the minutes. The meeting concluded in six minutes, with future agenda items flagged including a Schedule G analysis and 2027 spring coaches.

discussions.body: The committee took up the consent agenda under new business. The minutes record a motion to approve as presented, moved by Paul Nievinski and seconded by Donna Kaiser, which carried. No specific discussion or dissent was recorded.

discussions.item: Review of October and Preview of November In-Service Schedule
discussions.body: The committee reviewed the October in-service schedule and previewed the November in-service schedule. A motion to approve as presented was moved by Paul Nievinski and seconded by Donna Kaiser, and it carried. No detailed discussion was recorded in the minutes.
The committee identified two items for a future agenda: a Schedule G analysis and 2027 spring coaches. No motions were taken on these items at this meeting.

actionItems: October in-service review and November in-service preview approved as presented.

2027 Spring Coaches placed on a future agenda.
